notice: Synthetic statements invented for coursework testing; not real university policies.

sources.title: Synthetic AI Reading Group Notice
sources.text: The graduate AI reading group meets on Wednesday at 4 PM in Room 210. Attendees must register by Tuesday.

sources.title: Synthetic Research Poster Guidelines
sources.text: Research posters must be submitted as PDF files by Friday at noon. A maximum of one poster per team is permitted.

sources.title: Synthetic Dataset Access Policy
sources.text: Public benchmark datasets may be downloaded for teaching. Restricted datasets require project owner written approval.

sources.title: Synthetic Question Answering Evaluation Instructions
sources.text: For question answering evaluations, run three prompt variants with a fixed temperature and log answer citations.

sources.title: Synthetic API Security Guidelines
sources.text: Model API secrets must be stored in environment variables. Never place API keys in source control.
sources.author: Bhagyasri Uddandam

sources.title: Synthetic Prompt Engineering Office Hours
sources.text: Office hours for prompt engineering are Monday at 2 PM online.

sources.title: Synthetic Compute Credit Policy
